title: Execution record (draft for 0.2.0)
description: One applied write, as committed: served at GET /executions/:id (evidence token) and by the get_execution tool. A replay serves the same record. Not a receipt: the MWS receipt is the compact result every write tool returns. Version 1 allows additional top-level members: a later release may add one without a new version; a consumer ignores members it does not know.

seq.description: The store's commit sequence number: one per commit, from 1, never reused; the id is X-<seq>. A run reset also takes one (and has no execution record), so execution ids can skip a number. It is not a journal line number: a journal commit line carries it as commit_seq. The ledger has its own sequence and links here by execution_id.

fingerprint_hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 under the domain dev.writesafety.tiny-tracker/request-fingerprint/1 over the RFC 8785 bytes of {"body": <request body or null>, "method", "path", "principal"} (src/digest.ts fingerprintHash).

result.description: Under domain dev.writesafety.tiny-tracker/execution-result/1: the committed response body, with every server-generated value as committed.
